pages:error.title: 500 Error
pages:error.description: The default server-error response: own the fault, reassure the user about their work, and provide retry and status paths.

pages:maintenance.title: Maintenance
pages:maintenance.description: A planned-maintenance page with clear ownership, data reassurance, and update and return paths.

pages:not-found.title: 404 Not Found
pages:not-found.description: The default missing-page response: a character acknowledges the wrong turn, then offers a useful route home.

pages:offline.title: Offline
pages:offline.description: A calm offline state that keeps the user's place and distinguishes retry from genuinely available offline work.

pages:permission.title: Permission Required
pages:permission.description: A 403 state that explains the boundary without blame and offers request-access and switch-account actions.

pages:search-empty.title: No Search Results
pages:search-empty.description: A search-empty page that turns a dead end into concrete query and browse options.

pages:search-results.title: Search Results
pages:search-results.description: A focused search-results flow with persistent query context, meaningful type filters, restrained sorting, result summaries, pagination, and a useful empty state.

pages:status.title: System Status
pages:status.description: A public status page that leads with current health, shows service-level history, and keeps resolved incidents visible with plain-language context.

pages:analytics-dashboard.title: Analytics Dashboard
pages:analytics-dashboard.description: A decision-first analytics page composed from metric trends, a period control, and canonical line, bar, donut, area, and cohort plots with hover and keyboard inspection.
